description: Get the local taste profile (~/.muggle-ai/taste/profile.json) with each section's character count (statements, contexts and evidence excerpts) against the budget. Returns JSON { path, viewPath (readable profile.md), sectionUploadStatus: { <user|projectId>: { status: never-uploaded|matches-uploaded-copy|changed-since-upload, uploadedAt } }, characterBudget, userSectionCharacters, projectSectionCharacters, profile: { userSection, projectSections } }; an unbuilt profile has a null userSection and no projectSections.
name: muggle-local-taste-profile-get
